## What this manual covers

Use this manual when you want to understand a published measure, compare statistics or assess an important limitation. Links from individual pages lead to the relevant dashboards, briefings, tabulations and downloads.

| Manual | Main question answered |
|---|---|
| **Public Methods Manual** | What does this statistic mean, and how should I interpret it? |
| **[Operations Manual](../operations/index.qmd)** | What must BNR staff do, who decides and what evidence is retained? |
| **[Technical Manual](../technical/index.qmd)** | How do staff operate the analytics and publishing environment? |

The public manual does not contain patient information, software instructions, file paths or internal security details.
